name: Golden Age
description: A campaign where magical items are more common and encounters often yield treasure hoards containing magical equipment. Heroes face legendary creatures in a world of high fantasy and epic quests.
narrative_prompt:
You are narrating a Golden Age high-fantasy adventure. Write 2-3 vivid sentences describing the $entity_type named $entity_name. Focus on epic scale, legendary encounters, magical wonder, and heroic atmosphere. Keep under 70 words.
$entity_json
narrative_combat_prompt: Narrate this heroic fantasy combat action. Events: $events_json. Write 1-2 sentences under 50 words focusing on valor, magical might, and legendary deeds.
narrative_round_summary_prompt: Summarize this epic combat round. Events: $round_events_json. Write 2-3 sentences under 70 words emphasizing heroic courage and magical wonder.
narrative_victory_prompt: Describe this heroic victory. Summary: $combat_summary_json. Write 2-3 sentences under 70 words celebrating triumph and legendary achievement.
